sentences.text:
Shri
Rajkamal Chaturvedi - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Aaditya Narayan Gupta - Government
Advocate for State.
Heard on I.A.No.17839/2021, which is first application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C., for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant - Laxmi Prasad Kushwaha S/o Keshorilal Kushwaha .

Appellant - Laxmi Prasad Kushwaha , is aggrieved of the judgment dated 16.09.2021 passed by the learned Exclusive Special Judge POCSO Act, 2012, Katni (M.P.), in SC ATR No.180/2018, whereby,
appellant has been convicted for offence punishable under Section 363 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 03 years with fine of Rs.1000/-, Section 366 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I.
for 03 years with fine of Rs.1000/- and Section 376(3) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.3000/- respectively, with default stipulations.
It is submitted

entities.text: Exclusive Special Judge POCSO Act, 2012, Katni
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: that in the evidence of PW-9, father of the prosecutrix, he has categorically admitted that he does not remember the date of his marriage but, on his own he has stated that his marriage was performed in his childhood.
He also does not not remembered as to in which year his three children were born, but on his own he has stated that three children were born at a difference of two years each.
Thereafter, in para No.11 itself, he has stated that the school teacher used to visit their home and used to write the 2 CRA-5876-2021 date of birth.

Thereafter, he has stated that the date of birth of the prosecutrix is 26.07.2002 but when this Nagar Nigam certificate was produced it is seen that there is fluid put on the name and name has been corrected as 'Y', whereas PW-9 has admitted in his cross-examination that till 5th Class her name was 'X' and in 6th Class her name was changed from 'X' to 'Y'.
Her date of birth in the birth certificate is mentioned as 26.07.2002 whereas in the scholar register, it is mentioned as 15.06.2004.
Thus, there is material difference in the two date of birth certificates and the date of birth certificate issued by the Registrar Births and Deaths becomes doubtful.

In view of the manipulation in the certificate, whereby flute has been put in the column of name and 'Y' is mentioned, it also appears that 'X' name was never mentioned because the size of the fluid mark would not have covered the name 'X' as originally was given to the prosecutrix by her parents.

sentences.text: In view of such facts, when the date of birth certificate is doubtful and PW-8 prosecutrix has herself mentioned in her cross-examination that her marriage was performed with the appellant and they were living like a husband and wife, therefore, in view of doubtful date of birth, there are good chances of success of this appeal.
It is also submitted that it is a good case for acquittal.

Hence,
prayer is made to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and release him on bail.
Shri Aaditya Narayan Gupta, learned Government Advocate opposes the prayer of the appellant.

Taking these facts into consideration, fact of incarceration and other circumstances, it is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already 3 CRA-5876-2021 deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only), with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court o n 05.05.2025 and such other dates as may be fixed by the trial Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon Appellant - Laxmi Prasad Kushwaha shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
Accordingly, I.A.No.17839/2021 is allowed & disposed of .
Certified copy as per rules.
